analysis.allow_unnamed_speakers.description: When True, analysis modules treat diarized labels (SPEAKER_00, …) as eligible speakers instead of skipping until human names exist.

analysis.treat_as_single_speaker.description: When True, a single turn-taking speaker (e.g. import-minted SPEAKER_00) counts for modules that need at least one speaker without enabling full unnamed-speaker mode for multi-speaker meetings.
